The covariate-adjusted estimate of the average treatment effect is about 4.76. I got it from an OLS regression of `y` on `treatment` plus all 25 covariates.

The unadjusted difference in mean `y` between treated and control is 12.10. I did not use that figure because the treated and control groups differ on the confounders (only 18.6% of children are treated), so the raw difference is biased.

ANSWER: 4.76
